question: Under what temporal condition are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A duration of one year is stated.
That duration is linked to practice when practiced.
Old age and death are said to be destroyed.
inference: When practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The fused form yadā+abhyastañ is analyzed as given without internal split.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
